azure_quantum_forte_1_usd.note: Azure prints AQT = m + rates*gate-shots; IonQ's guide says cost is rounded up to the minimum. Both shown; the true invoice is set by the provider.

ionq_direct_usd.note: not published; use POST /jobs/estimate or dry_run + GET /jobs/{id}/cost with an API key

how_a_human_would_run_it: 1. Review this dry-run JSON (circuit QASM hash, backend, shots, cost estimates) yourself.
2. Obtain an IonQ API key from https://cloud.ionq.com and export it only in your own shell (export IONQ_API_KEY=...); never commit it or put it in a .env inside the repo tree.
3. Get a binding quote: submit with dry_run=True (qiskit-ionq >= 1.0.3) and read GET /jobs/{id}/cost, or POST /jobs/estimate (https://docs.ionq.com/guides/job-cost-and-usage).
4. export QMINT_ALLOW_PAID_HARDWARE=1 and QMINT_PAID_RUN_APPROVAL_TOKEN=<approval_token from this JSON>.

5. A lead-reviewed change must flip SUBMISSION_ENABLED_IN_THIS_BUILD and implement submission via qiskit_ionq.IonQProvider().get_backend('qpu.forte-1').run(qc, shots=...); record job id, backend, timestamps, shots, counts (bit order 'qiskit_clbit0_rightmost' via qiskit-ionq) and native gate counts in a BackendRunRecord with evidence_kind=QPU. Agents must never perform steps 2-5.
